text:
marta: Emergency poll — in a fire, which single office thing are you saving? this is not negotiable :fire:
teo: the succulent in the kitchen window. it's been through too much :potted_plant:
marta: it's alone, it has rights.
olivia: my laptop (duh) but also the giant duct-taped stuffed bear from last hackweek... he's named Mr. Adhesive
kevin: there's a sticker-covered chair in breakroom 2 (chair 17). chair 17 is a legend.
jen: chair 17??? that's the one that squeaks Morse code.
ryan: could we fit the succulent and mr. adhesive in a backpack? asking for teo.
marta: rule: one item. pick wisely.
ops-bot: Reminder: real fire, follow evacuation procedures. Do not re-enter building. https://redwood.example/safety :warning:
teo: fine, chair 17. if it survives deployments, it survives fire.
olivia: if we come back and chair 17's gone we riot :raised_fist:
kevin: propose official pledge: The Great Sticky Note Treaty — we'll give chair 17 a reserved desk marker :memo:
marta: voted. also can someone archive the Mr. Adhesive saga in the lore doc? @olivia please
olivia: on it. will add photos. camera roll incoming :camera_with_flash:
ryan: conclusion: Chair 17 + photo album. crisis averted :sunglasses:
jen: PTO request: week to mourn chair 17 if lost :joy:
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Safety checklist link: https://redwood.example/safety/checklist
